title: Density-Aware Translation of Spurious Correlations in Zero-Shot VLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification worst-group accuracy on the CelebA (hair color classification) and COVID-19 (pneumonia diagnosis) datasets, where gender acts as a spurious confounder.

Evaluating zero-shot classification worst-group accuracy on the FMoW dataset, where geographical region (Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania) serves as a spurious attribute for land-use and building classification.
Evaluating zero-shot classification worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset to measure the model's reliance on background context (land vs. water) rather than the main subject (bird type).
